decks.notes: The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to combo off and mill the opponent's library, while also utilizing artifacts like Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble to generate mana and draw cards. Emry, Lurker of the Loch helps to recur key pieces from the graveyard, while cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Jace, Wielder of Mysteries provide additional card draw and win conditions. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent and win the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of disruptive spells and aggressive creatures to pressure the opponent quickly. By using cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while deploying efficient threats like Tarmogoyf and Orcish Bowmasters, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control of the board. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Mishra's Bauble provide additional value and consistency to ensure the deck can maintain its aggressive game plan throughout the match.

This deck is focused on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Territorial Kavu, and Scion of Draco to efficiently deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to control the board and finish off opponents. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help protect your creatures and give them additional power. Consign to Memory can be used for removal or card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient threats and burn spells to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a mix of counter spells, removal, and disruption while utilizing powerful creatures such as Ketramose, the New Dawn and Psychic Frog to maintain board presence. The deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan through various means such as hand disruption with Thoughtseize, creature removal with Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending, and graveyard hate with Relic of Progenitus. By controlling the pace of the game and out-valuing your opponent with efficient spells and creatures, this deck aims to secure victory through careful decision-making and strategic plays.

The main focus of this deck is to abuse the Underworld Breach card by continuously filling the graveyard with artifacts and using Emry, Lurker of the Loch to recur them. This enables the player to create an infinite loop with Grinding Station, Malevolent Rumble, and Mishra's Bauble to mill the opponent's deck and win the game. The deck also includes cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Urza's Saga to ramp up resources and dig for combo pieces quickly. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling the combo pieces efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to recur cards from the graveyard, comboing with Grinding Station and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to mill the opponent's library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes mana acceleration with Mox Opal and Mox Amber, as well as card draw and filtering with Mishra's Bauble and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The inclusion of Urza's Saga helps to find key combo pieces and provide additional value. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to achieve victory.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to control the board state with cards like Fatal Push and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize and Consider. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Archmage's Charm to outvalue the opponent. With a mix of removal, countermagic, and card advantage, this deck seeks to outlast the opponent and win through attrition.

The deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and cards that allow for repeated blinking or flickering of those creatures, providing value and disruptive effects. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can protect its key threats and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Thoughtseize and Relic of Progenitus offer further disruption and control elements. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures and disruptive plays, maintaining pressure and tempo throughout the game.

The deck revolves around quickly assembling the pieces needed to ramp up and cast Primeval Titan, which can then be used to fetch Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and other key lands to deal lethal damage to the opponent. Cards like Amulet of Vigor and Explore help to accelerate this process, while other utility lands like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional support. Overall, the strategy is to leverage the synergies between lands and ramp spells to create a powerful combo that overwhelms the opponent with massive amounts of damage in a single turn.

This deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, often leading to a game-winning combo. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble help to fill the graveyard, while Urza's Saga and Mox Opal provide additional mana acceleration. Grinding Station and Malevolent Rumble serve as key pieces of the combo, allowing the player to mill their opponent or deal damage. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Flame of Anor provide card advantage and utility, while Lightning Bolt can be used for removal or to close out the game.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's plans and controlling the game through disruption cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Profane Tutor. It also aims to destroy the opponent's resources with cards like Pillage the Bog and Gaze of Granite, while ramping up its own resources with cards like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth. The deck is designed to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win through a combination of hand disruption, resource denial, and powerful late-game threats like Torment of Hailfire and Shadows' Verdict.

The deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and generate mana quickly in order to ramp into Primeval Titan. By using bounce lands like Simic Growth Chamber and utility lands like Urza's Saga, the deck can search for key pieces like Vesuva and Boseiju, Who Endures to further enhance the combo potential. Scapeshift and Summoner's Pact provide additional ways to search for Primeval Titan and close out the game with powerful land synergies. With efficient land ramp and strong combo potential, the deck aims to quickly assemble its key pieces and overwhelm the opponent with massive threats.

The deck aims to quickly ramp up mana and tutor for key combo pieces to cheat Primeval Titan into play. By using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Explore to accelerate, along with Amulet of Vigor to untap lands, the deck can generate a large amount of mana to play Primeval Titan early. The goal is to find and put Urza's Saga and Urza's lands into play, which can generate powerful tokens and further increase mana production. The deck also includes some utility lands and protection spells to ensure the combo can go off smoothly.

The main concept of this deck is to combine aggressive creatures with cards that allow for repeated blinking or flickering effects. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the player can continually return creatures to the battlefield, triggering their enter the battlefield effects multiple times. This strategy can disrupt the opponent's board state, generate card advantage, and create powerful synergies with creatures like Emperor of Bones and Witch Enchanter. With a mix of removal spells and hand disruption, this deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through ramping up mana with Eldrazi creatures and other spells to quickly cast high-cost, powerful spells like Emrakul, the Promised End and Karn, the Great Creator. It also utilizes various Eldrazi abilities to disrupt the opponent's strategy and keep them on the defensive. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats while maintaining control of the game through mana acceleration and powerful control spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble.

This UR Control deck aims to disrupt opponent's game plan by countering spells and removing threats while gaining card advantage through card draw and graveyard recursion. By controlling the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, and countering key spells with Counterspell and Spell Snare, this deck aims to outvalue opponents with cards like Snapcaster Mage and Crackling Drake. The tempo of the game is maintained through creature threats like Thundertrap Trainer and efficient removal, with land utility provided by fetch lands and versatile lands like Arena of Glory.
